2608.08713.title: Resolution Meets Reduction: Efficient Visual Context for 3D Radiology Report Generation
2608.08713.paper_summary: Vision-language models offer a promising path toward automating radiology report generation, but applying them to full 3D CT volumes poses substantial computational challenges. Modern foundation vision encoders (VEs) can produce tens of thousands of vision tokens per scan, making the visual sequence passed to the large language model (LLM) a primary computational bottleneck. Vision-to-language projectors can compress this sequence to reduce computation, but may discard clinically relevant detail; conversely, effective compression can accommodate higher-resolution inputs while keeping the downstream token count fixed. How this vision-token budget should be allocated across input field of view, spatial resolution, and vision-to-language projection therefore remains an open design question. We systematically evaluate four heterogeneous VEs (CNN- and ViT-based), five token-reducing projectors at up to 64x compression alongside a non-reducing MLP projector baseline, and five instruction-tuned LLMs (1.7B--4B) on two large-scale CT report datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin). At matched LLM token budgets, anatomy-guided region of interest cropping is the most consistent strategy, improving clinical macro F1 in 19 of 20 settings by +3.7 points on average for the 3D ViT Primus encoder and +1.1 for the slice-based 2D ViT Curia encoder. Increasing input resolution further is strongly projector-dependent: the PerceiverResampler, paired with higher-resolution Curia features, yields the strongest configuration in the resolution study on both datasets. Our best configurations achieve state-of-the-art clinical macro F1 on the test sets, reaching 49.5 on CT-RATE and 49.0 on Merlin. Code and models will be published upon publication.
2608.08713.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型提供了一條有前景的途徑來自動化放射科報告生成，但將它們應用於完整的3D CT體積面臨著重大的計算挑戰。現代基礎視覺編碼器（VEs）每次掃描可以產生數萬個視覺標記，使得傳遞給大型語言模型（LLM）的視覺序列成為主要的計算瓶頸。視覺到語言的投影器可以壓縮這個序列以減少計算，但可能會丟失臨床相關的細節；相反，有效的壓縮可以容納更高解析度的輸入，同時保持下游標記數量不變。因此，如何在輸入視野、空間解析度和視覺到語言的投影之間分配這個視覺標記預算仍然是一個未解的設計問題。我們系統地評估了四種異質的視覺編碼器（基於CNN和ViT）、五種最高可達64倍壓縮的減標記投影器以及一個不減標記的MLP投影器基準，還有五種經過指令調整的LLM（1.7B--4B），在兩個大型CT報告數據集（CT-RATE和Merlin）上進行測試。在匹配的LLM標記預算下，以解剖學為指導的感興趣區域裁剪是最一致的策略，對於3D ViT Primus編碼器在20個設置中平均提高了+3.7點的臨床宏F1，而對於基於切片的2D ViT Curia編碼器則提高了+1.1。進一步增加輸入解析度則強烈依賴於投影器：PerceiverResampler與更高解析度的Curia特徵配對，在兩個數據集的解析度研究中產生了最強的配置。我們的最佳配置在測試集上達到了最先進的臨床宏F1，CT-RATE達到49.5，Merlin達到49.0。代碼和模型將在出版時發布。
